intro: South Korea gave the world taekwondo, dominates Olympic archery and short-track skating, and is a powerhouse in esports.

chapters.title: Taekwondo and archery
text: Taekwondo, a martial art known for its high, fast kicks, developed in Korea and became an Olympic sport in 2000. Millions of children around the world learn it.

South Korea's women's archery team has won Olympic gold in every team event since it began in 1988, ten in a row up to Paris 2024. Short-track speed skating is another sport where Korea regularly wins gold.

chapters.title: Football and baseball
text: South Korea co-hosted the 2002 World Cup with Japan and reached the semi-finals. Son Heung-min became one of the Premier League's best forwards and captained Tottenham to the Europa League title in 2025.
Baseball is the most popular team sport, with lively crowds, cheerleaders and team songs.

chapters.title: Olympics, golf and esports
text: Seoul hosted the 1988 Summer Olympics and Pyeongchang the 2018 Winter Olympics, where North and South Korea marched together and fielded a joint women's ice hockey team. Kim Yuna won Olympic figure skating gold in 2010.
South Korean women are among the best golfers in the world. Esports are watched like traditional sports, and Faker is one of the most famous League of Legends players ever.
